q: An element has width: 100px; padding: 15px; border: 5px solid black;. What is its total width if box-sizing: content-box;?
explanation: With box-sizing: content-box;, the total width is the sum of the width, padding (15px+15px), and border (5px+5px), totaling 140px.

q: Identify the issue: div { width: 100%; padding: 20px; } without using box-sizing: border-box;
options: The div will be wider than its parent
The div's width is too small
answer: The div will be wider than its parent
explanation: Without box-sizing: border-box;, the padding is added to the 100% width, making the div wider than its parent container.
